101/**
102 * Provide a way of displaying "text", corresponding to
103 * "keys" in a {@code JComboBox} . The combo display values are created
104 * by an {@link ListItemFormat}. If not specified, keys are auto-generated
105 * [0-N); and in this case {@code <K>} must be "Integer" or "Long". In some
106 * applications, a key is a key in some database table, see
107 * {@linkplain SsDbComboBox2}. There are convenience methods for using an enum
108 * for both "text" and "keys", see
109 * {@link #setDisplayValues(java.lang.Class)}.
110 * <p>
111 * This is the base class for combo boxes; it uses/handles {@link #getAllowNull()
112 * getAllowNull()}/{@link #setAllowNull(boolean) setAllowNull(boolean)},
113 * and tracks metadata changes, for adding/removing nullItem to the item list.
114 * In addition, there are JComboBox models for use with or without glazed lists;
115 * these models have static methods for hooking things up to the JComboBox,
116 * see {@linkplain ModelType}, which is used with
117 * {@link Builder#modelType(dev.visdb.seesaw.core.ComboBox2.ModelType)
118 * Builder.modelType(modelType)}
119 * to select the model type.
120 * <p>
121 * See <a href="DBComboBox2.html#builders-and-generics">
122 * DBComboBox2 examples of working with {@code Builder}s.</a>
123 * <p>
124 * <b>Warning:
125 * This combo box automatically inserts an item when {@link #getAllowNull()} is true.
126 * This comboBox may use GlazedLists which dynamically changes the contents
127 * of the combo box list.
128 * Do not use methods that are based on index in the combo box list, unless
129 * you're sure...</b>
130 * For example use
131 * {@link SsComboBox2#getChosenKey() getChosenKey()}
132 * not something that is based on {@code getSelectedIndex()}.
133 * Change the current/selected combo box item with methods
134 * such as
135 * {@link SsComboBox2#setChosenKey(java.lang.Object) setChosenKey(K)}
136 * and
137 * {@link SsComboBox2#setChosenDisplayValue(java.lang.Object) setChosenDisplayValue(D)}.
138 * Use the methods {@link SsComboBox2#hasItems() hasItems() } and
139 * {@link SsComboBox2#hasSelection() hasSelection() } which take into account
140 * {@code getAllowNull()}.
141 * <p>
142 * Notice that: {@link SsComboBox2#getChosenKey() getChosenKey()}
143 * returns null in two situations related to {@link #getAllowNull() }
144 * <ul>
145 *   <li>nothing is selected in this combo box
146 *   <li>the <em>nullItem</em> is selected in this combo box
147 * </ul>
148 * <p>
149 * {@code getSelectedItem() == null } indicates there is no
150 * combo box selection; it is different than {@code !hasSelection()}
151 * when {@code getAllowNull()} is true.
152 * <p>
153 * If subclasses need to work directly with the combo box model,
154 * refer to {@link dev.visdb.seesaw.models.KeyDisplayValueSwingModel}
155 * and especially
156 * {@link KeyDisplayValueSwingModel.Remodel}
157 * <p>
158 * Here's an example of using auto-generated keys
159 * {@snippet class=ComboBoxSnippets region=auto_gen}
160 * The generated keys start at zero, the key:value pairs for the above are:
161 * {@literal {0: "111", 1: "2222", 2: "33333"}}.
162 * <p>
163 * To provide your own keys, set the keys along with the options.
164 * <br>
165 * {@snippet class=ComboBoxSnippets region=custom_key}
166 * <p>
167 * Classes that extend this class, should use {@link #adjustForNullItem() }
168 * after clearing the itemList or when a change is made that might affect
169 * whether or not a nullItem is required.
170 <p>
171 * Note that if you do not want to use the auto-generated keys, the keys
172 * must be set before invoking the
173 * {@link dev.visdb.seesaw.navigate.RowsModel#bind(dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SSComponent, java.lang.String) bind()}
174 * method to associate the combobox to a database column.
175 * <p>
176 * Initially no D2.
177 * @param <K> key type
178 * @param <D> displayValue type
179 * @param <D2> d2 type
180 * @since 4.0.0
181 */
182@SuppressWarnings("serial")
183public class SsComboBox2<K, D, D2> extends JComboBox<ListItem> implements SsComponent {
184  /** A convenience for variable declarations. Do not instantiate. */
185  protected abstract class Model extends KeyDisplayValueSwingModel<K, D, D2> {}

193     */

195    /**
196     * Use swing model.
197     */
198    SWING,
199  }

201  /**
202   * Listener(s) for the component's value used to propagate changes back to the rowset in certain instances.
203   * <p>
204   * NOTE: No guaranty whether ActionListener or FocusLister will be called first when focus is lost.
205   */
206  protected class ComboBox2Listener implements ActionListener {
207    /**
208     * For JComboBox ActionListener and ItemListener are similar, but ActionListener
209     * seems more appropriate since we don't care about the de-selection of the
210     * previously selected item.
211     *
212     * Per https://docs.oracle.com/javase/tutorial/uiswing/components/combobox.html#listeners
213     * ActionListener just tells us that the selection changed whereas
214     * ItemListener fires separate events for deselection of previous item
215     * and selection of current item.
216     *
217     * {@inheritDoc}
218     */
219    @Override
220    public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent ae) {
221      // Return if a combo navigator, SSSyncManager will have it's own
222      // listeners. This listener for keeping a bound column in sync.
223      if (isComboBoxNavigator()) {
224        logger.log(DEBUG, () -> sf("%s: Action Listener isComboBoxNavigator.", getColumnForLog()));
225        return;
226      }
227
228      logger.log(
229          DEBUG,
230          () -> sf("%s: About to update RowSet with %s.", getColumnForLog(), getSelectedItem()));
231
232      K key = getChosenKey();
233      try {
234        dbChange(() -> setColumnObject(key));
235      } catch (SQLException ex) {
236        logger.log(Level.ERROR, (String) null, ex);
237      }
238    }
239  }
240
241  /**
242   * Listens/waits for selected item not nullItem. When not nullItem is
243   * set, selectionPending set to false.
244   */
245  private final class ComboBox2ItemListener implements ItemListener {
246    @Override
247    public void itemStateChanged(ItemEvent e) {
248      //System.err.println(e.paramString());
249      if (e.getStateChange() == ItemEvent.SELECTED) {
250        // Move cleanupMissing... to updateSsComponent so that the
251        // combo list doesn't change while a row is displayed.
252        // If needed, could have a control option for when
253        // to do the cleanup.
254        // cleanupMissingKeyVisuals();
255        if (getSelectedItem() != nullItem && selectionPending) {
256          setSelectionPending(false);
257          //System.err.println("itemStateChanged true --> false");
258        }
259      }
260    }
261  }

295  /**
296   * KeyDisplayValue model for use with GlazedLists; this model has methods
297   * for building and manipulating the EventList and supports locking.
298   * @param <K> key type
299   * @param <D> displayValue type
300   * @param <D2> d2 type
301   */
302  protected static class BaseGlazedModel<K, D, D2>
303      extends GlazedListsKeyDisplayValueInfo<K, D, D2> {
304    /**
305     * The GlazedLists auto completion support for the
306     * associated JComboBox.
307     */
308    protected AutoCompleteSupport<ListItem> autoComplete;
309
310    /**
311     * Create a model that has a glazed EventList;
312     * install autocompletion in the specified JComboBox.
313     *
314     * @param <K> key type
315     * @param <D> displayValue type
316     * @param <D2> d2 type
317     * @param jc install auto completion into this
318     * @return KeyDisplayValue model
319     */
320    protected static <K, D, D2> BaseGlazedModel<K, D, D2> install(SsComboBox2<K, D, D2> jc) {
321      BaseGlazedModel<K, D, D2> model = new BaseGlazedModel<>();
322      model.autoComplete = AutoCompleteSupport.install(jc, model.getEventList(), null,
323                                                       model.getListItemFormatDelegate());
324
325      model.autoComplete.setFilterMode(TextMatcherEditor.CONTAINS);
326      model.autoComplete.setStrict(true);
327      model.autoComplete.setPositionCaretTowardZero(true);
328
329      // RESTORE JCOMBOBOX UP/DOWN ARROW HANDLING OVERRIDING GLAZEDLIST
330      jc.glazedListArrowHandler();
331
332      return model;
333    }
334
335    /**
336     * Create a model with a glazed EventList.
337     */
338    @SuppressWarnings("Convert2Diamond")
339    protected BaseGlazedModel() {
340      // false means no D2
341      super(HasD2.FALSE, new BasicEventList<ListItem>());
342    }
343  }

380  /**
381   * A list item formatter that displays the key if the displayValue is null.
382   */
383  @SuppressWarnings("serial")
384  class ShowKeyIfNullDisplayValue extends ListItemFormat {
385    /**
386     * If null displayValue, then show the key; otherwise do the default
387     * formatting.
388     *
389     * @param sb display value goes in here
390     * @param elemIndex which displayValue to format
391     * @param listItem combobox list item
392     */
393    @Override
394    protected void appendValue(StringBuffer sb, int elemIndex, ListItem listItem) {
395      if (getDisplayValueFormatIndex() == elemIndex && getElem(elemIndex, listItem) == null
396          && !Objects.equals(getNullItem(), listItem)) {
397        Object key = getElem(getKeyFormatIndex(), listItem);
398        sb.append(key != null ? key.toString() : null).append(" - DisplayValue Not Found");
399      } else {
400        super.appendValue(sb, elemIndex, listItem);
401      }
402    }
403  }

507  /**
508   * To build a SsComboBox2 with the specified parameters.
509   *
510   * @param <K>
511   * @param <D>
512   * @param <D2>
513   * @param <T>
514   */
515  public abstract static class AbstractBuilder<K, D, D2, T extends AbstractBuilder<K, D, D2, T>> {
516    private ModelType modelType = DEFAULT_MODEL_COMBO2;
517    private boolean d2DisplayEnabled;
518    /** TypeToken K */
519    protected final TypeToken<K> typeTokenK = new TypeToken<K>(getClass()) {};
520    /** TypeToken D */
521    protected final TypeToken<D> typeTokenD = new TypeToken<D>(getClass()) {};
522    /** TypeToken D2 */
523    protected final TypeToken<D2> typeTokenD2 = new TypeToken<D2>(getClass()) {};
524
525    /** AbstractBuilder */
526    public AbstractBuilder() {
527      verifyTypeClass(typeTokenK, getClass());
528      verifyTypeClass(typeTokenD, getClass());
529      verifyTypeClass(typeTokenD2, getClass());
530    }
531
532    /**
533     * {@link ModelType#GLAZED} or {@link ModelType#SWING};
534     * default: {@link ModelType#SWING}.
535     * @param val
536     * @return
537     */
538    public T modelType(ModelType val) {
539      modelType = Objects.requireNonNull(val);
540      return self();
541    }
542
543    /**
544     * Should {@code <D2>} values be displayed; default: false.
545     * @param val
546     * @return
547     */
548    public T d2DisplayEnabled(boolean val) {
549      d2DisplayEnabled = val;
550      return self();
551    }
552
553    /** @return */
554    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
555    protected abstract T self();
556
557    /** @return the created SsComboBox2 */
558    public abstract SsComboBox2<K, D, D2> build();
559  }

603  /**
604   * Create BaseComboBox.
605   * @param modelType whether to use SWING or GLAZED combo model
606   */
607  @SuppressWarnings("LeakingThisInConstructor")
608  private SsComboBox2(ModelType modelType) {
609    addItemListener(new ComboBox2ItemListener());
610    finishSsCommon();
611
612    keyVisual = switch (modelType) {
613      case GLAZED -> BaseGlazedModel.install(this);
614      case SWING -> BaseModel.install(this);
615    };
616    keyVisual.setListItemFormat(new ShowKeyIfNullDisplayValue());
617  }

619  /**
620   * Verify that the {@code typeToken } captured a concrete type.
621   * @param typeToken
622   * @param builderClass used to generate useful message
623   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if concrete type was not captured
624   */
625  protected static final void verifyTypeClass(TypeToken<?> typeToken, Class<?> builderClass)
626      throws IllegalArgumentException {
627    if (isConcrete(typeToken))
628      return;
629
630    // This might be handy, if "xxx.yyy.zzz$1", following give "xxx.yyy.zzz"
631    // builderClass.getEnclosingClass();
632    // Pattern p1 = Pattern.compile("(.*)([$][^$]+)$");
633    // Matcher m1 = p1.matcher("one.two$three$four"); // "one.two$three", "$four"
634
635    String className = builderClass.getCanonicalName();
636    boolean isDollar = false;
637    if (className == null) {
638      className = builderClass.getName(); // like "com.one.two$1"
639      isDollar = true;
640    }
641
642    Matcher matcher = Pattern.compile("(\\w+)[.$](\\w+)$").matcher(className);
643    String msgName = "Some.Builder";
644    if (matcher.find()) {
645      msgName = isDollar ? matcher.group(1) + ".Builder" : matcher.group();
646    }
647
648    throw new IllegalArgumentException(sf("'%s' unresolved, non generic subclass required,"
649                                              + " See DBComboBox2 javadoc,"
650                                              + " use '{ }' on the Builder, like 'new %s<>() { }'",
651                                          typeToken.getType(), msgName));
652  }
653
654  /**
655   * Is the TypeToken generic or not.
656   * @param token
657   * @return  true if not generic
658   */
659  protected static boolean isConcrete(TypeToken<?> token) {
660    Type type = token.getType();
661
662    if (type instanceof ParameterizedType pType) {
663      for (Type arg : pType.getActualTypeArguments()) {
664        // If any argument is still a generic TypeVariable or WildcardType, it's not concrete
665        if (!(arg instanceof Class)) {
666          return false;
667        }
668      }
669      return true;
670    }
671    // Base case: Not a parameterized type, but is a concrete class
672    return type instanceof Class;
673  }

710  public final void setListItemFormat(ListItemFormat listItemFormat) {
711    Object selectedItem = getSelectedItem();
712    boolean keep = Objects.equals(getEditor().getItem(), selectedItem);
713    keyVisual.setListItemFormat(listItemFormat);
714    // A new format may change the target contents of the comboBox editor.
715    // When it does change, the contents of the combo editor is changed
716    // from ListItem to a String with the old value.

793  /**
794   * Control whether or not waiting for pending user selection.
795   * When * selectionPending is true, there is a nullItem and it is selected in
796   * the * combo. selectionPending is set to false automatically when a non nullItem
797   * is selected.
798   *
799   * @param selectionPending true selects a possibly tempory nullItem
800   */
801  public void setSelectionPending(boolean selectionPending) {
802    if (this.selectionPending == selectionPending) {
803      return;
804    }
805    this.selectionPending = selectionPending;
806
807    adjustForNullItem();
808    if (selectionPending) {
809      // Setting to true from false, select the nullItem;
810      // Events are a problem. After DbOpsImpl.setSelectionPending
811      // the following ends up in ComboBox2Listener.actionPerformed()
812      // then into setColumnText then exception in RowSetOps.updateColumnText.
813      // TODO: merge this into adjustForNullItem, to avoid extra unregister/register
814      //
815      // Or better, with cleaner event model, like Navigator events,
816      // might be easier to avoid RowSetOps.updateColumnText.
817      // Actually, if there was an error badge next to the ComboBox
818      // (instead of those f*ing dialogs) then when AllowNull is false
819      // the blank combo would start with the error badge after inster row.
820      // That sounds pretty good.
821      final ActionListener[] listeners = unregisterAllActionListeners(this);
822      try {
823        super.setSelectedItem(nullItem);
824      } finally {
825        registerAllActionListeners(this, listeners);
826      }
827    }
828  }

896  /**
897   * Set up the specified keys/displayValues.
898   * <p>
899   * If _keys is null, then autogenerate the keys; _keys type must be Integer
900   * or Long.
901   *
902   * @param _displayValues
903   * @param _keys
904   * @param _d2s
905   */
906  protected void setDisplayValuesInternal(List<D> _displayValues, List<K> _keys, List<D2> _d2s) {
907    Objects.requireNonNull(_displayValues);
908    if (_keys == null && getKeyType() != Integer.class && getKeyType() != Long.class)
909      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Auto generated key only avaialable for int/long keys");
910    if (_keys != null && _displayValues.size() != _keys.size())
911      throw new IllegalArgumentException("DisplayValues and Keys different length");
912    if (_d2s != null && _displayValues.size() != _d2s.size())
913      throw new IllegalArgumentException("DisplayValues and D2s different length");
914    try (Model.Remodel remodel = keyVisual.getRemodel()) {
915      List<K> keys = _keys;
916      autoGeneratedKeys = false;
917      if (keys == null) {
918        // Provide a [0,N) key
919        // TODO: in the future let it be implicit, don't create it?
920        List<Object> autoKeys;
921        if (getKeyType() == Integer.class)
922          autoKeys = Arrays.asList(IntStream.range(0, _displayValues.size()).boxed().toArray());
923        else // must be Long
924          autoKeys = Arrays.asList(LongStream.range(0, _displayValues.size()).boxed().toArray());
925        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
926        List<K> xxx = (List<K>) autoKeys;
927        keys = xxx;
928        autoGeneratedKeys = true;
929      }
930      keys = keyVisual.getDisconnectedList(keys);
931      List<D> displayValues = keyVisual.getDisconnectedList(_displayValues);
932      List<D2> d2s = keyVisual.getDisconnectedList(_d2s);
933      remodel.clear();
934
935      hasD2 = d2s != null;
936      keyVisual.setD2Enabled(hasD2());
937
938      nullItem = null;
939
940      establishListItemFormat(JdbcDataTypeConversionTables.classToJdbcType(getDisplayValueType()),
941                              JdbcDataTypeConversionTables.classToJdbcType(getD2Type()));
942
943      // TODO first item is nullItem if getAllowNull()==true.
944      //      Impacts keys, getSelectedValue(), getSelectedIndex(), etc.
945      adjustForNullItem();
946      remodel.addAll(keys, displayValues, d2s);
947    }
948  }

960  /**

962   * list item's key equals the param.

965   * changed.

971  public boolean removeKey(K key) {

973
974    try (Model.Remodel remodel = keyVisual.getRemodel()) {
975      // Get index of list item for key.
976      int index = remodel.getKeys().indexOf(key);
977      // Proceed if key was found.
978      if (index != -1) {
979        remodel.remove(index);
980        result = true;
981      }
982    } catch (final Exception e) {
983      logger.log(Level.ERROR, getColumnForLog() + ": Exception.", e);
984    }
985
986    return result;
987  }

1021  /**
1022   * Update displayValue of an item in the combobox's item list for given key.
1023   * <p>
1024   * If more than one item is present in the combo for that key, only the
1025   * first one is changed.
1026   *
1027   * @param key typically a primary key value corresponding to the
1028   *                 chosenDisplayValue to be updated
1029   * @param displayValue  chosenDisplayValue that should be updated in the combobox
1030   *
1031   * @return returns true if update is successful otherwise returns false.
1032   */
1033  public boolean updateDisplayValue(K key, D displayValue) {
1034    // 2021-02-28: @errael patched this method to deal with inconsistent
1035    // updating of combo editor. See https://github.com/bpangburn/swingset/issues/85
1036
1037    boolean result = false;
1038
1039    try (Model.Remodel remodel = keyVisual.getRemodel()) {
1040      final int index = remodel.getKeys().indexOf(key);
1041      if (index >= 0) {
1042        boolean isSelectedItem = Objects.equals(key, getChosenKey());
1043        remodel.setDisplayValue(index, displayValue);
1044        result = true;
1045        // Changing what's in the ComboEditor, which may be done indirectly when
1046        // modifying the current item, might change the currently selected item
1047        // when GlazedList is set to STRICT. So something is needed to insure
1048        // that the selected key before the change is the selected key
1049        // after the change. Otherwise the first item in the list becomes
1050        // selected. If the combo is used for navigation, this can trigger a
1051        // change in the current row.
1052        //
1053        // The call to setSelectedItem() below has the added benefit of working
1054        // around a possible bug in GlazedList
1055        // (see https://github.com/glazedlists/glazedlists/issues/702),
1056        // but it's likely best to keep this block even if the issue is
1057        // determined to be a bug and resolved.
1058        if (isSelectedItem) {
1059          // Modifying the underlying list item that corresponds to the
1060          // current selection; strict glazed may change the selection.
1061          // Select the modified item so the same key is selected.
1062          ListItem item = remodel.get(index);
1063          setSelectedItem(item);
1064        }
1065        // TODO Confirm that eventList is not reordered by GlazedLists code.
1066      }
1067    }
1068
1069    return result;
1070  }
1071
1072  /**
1073   * Optimization that only calls getRemodel once.
1074   * Most meaningful when getRemodel does locking.
1075   * 
1076   * @param <R> optional return type
1077   * @param fnConstructItem
1078   * @return optional, empty if chosen item is not an ListItem
1079   */
1080
1081  protected <R extends Item2<K, D, D2>> Optional<R> getChosenItem(
1082      BiFunction<Model.Remodel, ListItem, R> fnConstructItem) {
1083    try (Model.Remodel remodel = keyVisual.getRemodel()) {
1084      Object item = getSelectedItem();
1085      if (item instanceof ListItem lItem) {
1086        return Optional.of(fnConstructItem.apply(remodel, lItem));
1087      }
1088      return Optional.empty();
1089    }
1090  }

1092  /**
1093   * Return a copy of the chosenItem with methods getKey(), getDisplayValue();
1094   * if {@link #hasD2()} there's also getD2().
1095   * <p>
1096   * Here's an example of creating a non-generic version of
1097   * getChosenItem().
1098   * {@snippet class=ComboBoxSnippets region=chosen_item}
1099   * @return a copy of the chosen item
1100   */
1101  // TODO: return new Item2<>(ListItem); // would that be better?
1102  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1103  public Item2<K, D, D2> getChosenItem() {
1104    Optional<Item2<K, D, D2>> item = getChosenItem((remodel, lItem) -> {
1105      return new Item2<>(remodel.getKey(lItem), remodel.getDisplayValue(lItem),
1106          hasD2() ? remodel.getD2(lItem) : (D2)Item2.NO_D2); // D2 cast unchecked
1107    });
1108    return item.orElse(new Item2<>(null, null, hasD2() ? null : (D2)Item2.NO_D2));
1109    // return !hasD2() ? new Item2<>(getChosenKey(), getChosenDisplayValue())
1110    //     : new Item2<>(getChosenKey(), getChosenDisplayValue(), getChosenD2());
1111  }

1138  private final List<K> generatedKeyVisuals = new ArrayList<>();
1139  private int addMissingKeyVisual(Model.Remodel remodel, K key) {
1140    int index = -1;
1141    if (key != null) {
1142      if (missingDisplayValueControl.contains(MissingDisplayValueControl.MC_ADD)) {
1143        remodel.add(key, null);
1144        index = remodel.getKeys().indexOf(key);
1145        logger.log(DEBUG, () -> "missingKeyDisplayvalue added: " + key);
1146        generatedKeyVisuals.add(key);
1147      }
1148    }
1149    return index;
1150  }
1151
1152  /**
1153   * If current selection does not have a null displayValue,
1154   * then remove any created missingKeyDisplayValues from list.
1155   */
1156  private void cleanupMissingKeyVisuals() {
1157    if (!SwingUtilities.isEventDispatchThread())
1158      throw new IllegalStateException("Must be EDT.");
1159    if (generatedKeyVisuals.isEmpty()
1160        || !missingDisplayValueControl.contains(MissingDisplayValueControl.MC_CLEANUP))
1161      return;
1162    if (generatedKeyVisuals.size() > 1)
1163      logger.log(WARNING, () -> "size: " + generatedKeyVisuals.size());
1164    try (Model.Remodel remodel = keyVisual.getRemodel()) {
1165      for (Iterator<K> it = generatedKeyVisuals.iterator(); it.hasNext();) {
1166        K missingKeyVisual = it.next();
1167        // Sequential records might have different missing displayValues;
1168        // never remove a missing displayValue for the current selected key.
1169        if (Objects.equals(missingKeyVisual, getChosenKey()))
1170          continue;
1171        int index = remodel.getKeys().indexOf(missingKeyVisual);
1172        if (index != -1) {
1173          ListItem removed = remodel.remove(index);
1174          logger.log(DEBUG, () -> "missingKeyDisplayValue removed: " + removed);
1175        } else {
1176          logger.log(WARNING, () -> "not in combo: " + missingKeyVisual);
1177        }
1178        it.remove(); // it's not in the combo list anymore
1179      }
1180    }
1181  }
1182
1183  private final EnumSet<MissingDisplayValueControl> missingDisplayValueControl
1184      = EnumSet.allOf(MissingDisplayValueControl.class);
1185
1186  /**
1187   * Flags to control handling of Key
1188   * without a specified DisplayValue;
1189   * see {@link #setMissingDisplayValueControl(java.util.EnumSet) } for
1190   * meaning of the flags.
1191   */
1192  public enum MissingDisplayValueControl {
1193    /**
1194     * Automatically generate list item entry when current key
1195     * does not have a displayValue.
1196     */
1197    MC_ADD,
1198
1199    /**
1200     * Remove any auto gen entry if current current key has a displayValue.
1201     */
1202    MC_CLEANUP;
1203  }
1204
1205  /**
1206   * Set the flags that control how a Key
1207   * without a specified displayValue is
1208   * handled. If {@code MC_ADD} and a Key is encountered and no DisplayValue
1209   * was specified, a combobox list entry is created for the Key with null
1210   * displayValue; a custom message, see
1211   * {@link #setListItemFormat(dev.visdb.seesaw.models.SSListItemFormat)},
1212   * may be setup for handling these entries for the combobox display.If
1213   * {@code MC_CLEANUP} then when the combobox navigates away from an entry
1214   * with a missing displayValue, the automatically created list entry is
1215   * removed.<p>
1216   * Flags default to {@code MC_ADD} and {@code MC_CLEANUP}.
1217   *
1218   * @param flags new value
1219   * @return previous value
1220   */
1221  public EnumSet<MissingDisplayValueControl> setMissingDisplayValueControl(
1222      EnumSet<MissingDisplayValueControl> flags) {
1223    EnumSet<MissingDisplayValueControl> prev = missingDisplayValueControl.clone();
1224    missingDisplayValueControl.clear();
1225    missingDisplayValueControl.addAll(flags);
1226    return prev;
1227  }
1228
1229  /**
1230   * Sets the selected ComboBox item according to the specified key.
1231   * The selectedItem is set to nullItem or null if key not found.
1232   * <p>
1233If called from updateSsComponent() from a RowSet change then the Component
1234listener should already be turned off. Otherwise we want it on so the
1235ultimate call to setSelectedItem() will trigger an update the to RowSet.
1236   *
1237   * @param key key of item value to assign to combobox,
1238   *                 which may or may not correlate to the combobox index
1239   */
1240  public void setChosenKey(K key) {
1241    logger.log(DEBUG,
1242               sf("%s: current value: %s, new value: %s.", getColumnForLog(), getChosenKey(), key));
1243
1244    try (Model.Remodel remodel = keyVisual.getRemodel()) {
1245      if (!hasItems()) {
1246        logger.log(WARNING, sf("%s: combobox is empty", getColumnForLog()));
1247        // Doesn't have items, that doesn't mean that the list is empty.
1248        // Make sure the appropriate null is selected.
1249        setSelectedItem(nullItem);
1250        return;
1251      }
1252
1253      // only need to proceed if there is a change.
1254      if (Objects.equals(key, getChosenKey())) {
1255        return;
1256      }
1257
1258      int index = remodel.getKeys().indexOf(key);
1259      ListItem item;
1260      if (index != -1) {
1261        item = remodel.get(index);
1262      } else if ((index = addMissingKeyVisual(remodel, key)) != -1) {
1263        item = remodel.get(index);
1264      } else {
1265        // nullItem is either special first list item
1266        // or it is null. It is null when getAllowNull() is false
1267        item = nullItem;
1268        // BP_2021-02-16:
1269        // We expect to get here if we have a child combo where the contents
1270        // are requeried on each record. As soon as a navigation occurs, the
1271        // component values are cleared and then the new value is loaded,
1272        // but the combo has not been re-queried yet so there are no matches
1273        // for setChosenKey() and we call setSelectedItem(nullItem).
1274        // This is OK so long as the component listener used for binding
1275        // is removed/disabled because the rowset will not get the null value.
1276        // Later when the combo is requeried, the component will try to load
1277        // the current column value from the rowset and this time
1278        // setChosenKey() should succeed.
1279        if (SsUtils.isSsComponentListenerAddedDebug(this)) {
1280          logger.log(Level.ERROR,
1281                     () -> sf("%s: No key for %s in combobox, setSelectedItem(null)",
1282                              getColumnForLog(), key));
1283        }
1284      }
1285      setSelectedItem(item);
1286
1287      logger.log(
1288          TRACE,
1289          () -> sf("%s: eventList - [%s].", getColumnForLog(), remodel.getItemList().toString()));
1290      logger.log(TRACE,
1291                 () -> sf("%s: displayvalues - [%s].", getColumnForLog(),
1292                          remodel.getDisplayValues().toString()));
1293      logger.log(TRACE,
1294                 () -> sf("%s: keys - [%s].", getColumnForLog(), remodel.getKeys().toString()));
1295    }
1296  }

1334  /**
1335   * Finds the listItem having displayValue that matches the specified
1336   * displayValue and make it the selected listItem. If no matching item is
1337   * found the displayValue is used for
1338   * {@link #setSelectedItem(java.lang.Object) setSelectedItem(displayValue)}.
1339   *
1340   * @param displayValue element of list item
1341   */
1342  public void setChosenDisplayValue(D displayValue) {
1343    try (Model.Remodel remodel = keyVisual.getRemodel()) {
1344      if (!hasItems()) {
1345        logger.log(WARNING, sf("%s: combobox is empty", getColumnForLog()));
1346        // Even if combo is empty, stick displayValue in editor. Do not return;
1347      }
1348
1349      Object tItem = getSelectedItem();
1350      // Extract the displayValue from the selected list item.
1351      // If not an ListItem, it's editable, use it as current displayValue.
1352      Object chosenDisplayValue
1353          = tItem instanceof ListItem ? remodel.getDisplayValue((ListItem) tItem) : tItem;
1354
1355      // only need to proceed if there is a change.
1356      if (Objects.equals(displayValue, chosenDisplayValue)) {
1357        return;
1358      }
1359
1360      // find the first matching displayValue in the list
1361      final int index = remodel.getDisplayValues().indexOf(displayValue);
1362
1363      Object item;
1364      if (index != -1) {
1365        item = remodel.get(index);
1366      } else {
1367        // Didn't find it in the list, so just use it as is.
1368        item = displayValue != null ? displayValue : nullItem;
1369        logger.log(WARNING,
1370                   () -> sf("%s: displayValue %s not in combobox, do setSelectedItem.",
1371                            getColumnForLog(), displayValue));
1372      }
1373
1374      setSelectedItem(item);
1375    }
1376  }

1379  //
1380  // Using an enum as an displayValue/key.
1381  //
1382
1383  //
1384  // TODO: Study use case for enums
1385  // TODO: When an enum is specified, should there be a way to
1386  //        specify a key as well? Two possibilities, the first
1387  //        is like the general pattern, key should have the
1388  //        same number of elements as there are enum values.
1389  //        The second could also be provided as setDisplayValues([], Function)
1390  //         1) setDisplayValues(enum, key)
1391  //         2) setDisplayValues(enum, Function<enum, Object>)
1392  //            For example
1393  //                setDisplayValues(ComboEnum.class, (e) -> e.someMethod())
1394  //                setDisplayValues(ComboEnum.class, (e) -> someMap.get(e))
1395
1396  private Class<?> enumVisual;
1397
1398  /**
1399   * Sets the displayValues to be displayed in the combo box based on
1400   * the {@code Enum}'s {@code toString()}. Generate {@literal [0-N)} keys.
1401   * <p>
1402   * Convenience method, throws if displayValue type/class, {@code <D>},
1403   * is not String.
1404   *
1405   * @param <T> inferred enum type
1406   * @param enumDisplayValues enum class with values to display
1407   */
1408  public <T extends Enum<T>> void setDisplayValues(Class<T> enumDisplayValues) {
1409    if (getDisplayValueType() != String.class)
1410      throw new IllegalArgumentException("DisplayValue type must be String for Enum displayValues");
1411
1412    this.enumVisual = enumDisplayValues;
1413    List<String> l01 = Stream.of(enumDisplayValues.getEnumConstants())
1414                           .map(e -> e.toString())
1415                           .collect(Collectors.toList());
1416
1417    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1418    List<D> l02 = (List<D>) l01;
1419    setDisplayValuesInternal(l02, null, null);
1420  }

1429    return enumVisual;

1432  /**
1433   * Finds the listItem that matches the specified enum and make it the selected
1434   * listItem.
1435   *
1436   * @param displayValue select list item for this
1437   * @throws ClassCastException if displayValue is wrong enum type
1438   */
1439  public void setChosenEnum(Enum<?> displayValue) {
1440    if (enumVisual == null) {
1441      throw new IllegalStateException("SSComboBox values not an enum.");
1442    }
1443    Objects.requireNonNull(displayValue, "Enum to be selected cannnot be null.");
1444
1445    // Verify the enum of of the correct type.
1446    enumVisual.cast(displayValue);
1447    // This could be performance optimized since itemList index == ordinal()
1448    // within the current constraints of key == ordinal().
1449    // But the whole nullItem comes into play to affect the index.
1450    setChosenKey(getKeyType().cast(displayValue.ordinal()));
1451  }

1453  /**
1454   * Return the selected enum.
1455   *
1456   * @return selected enum.
1457   * @throws IllegalStateException if not an enum.
1458   */
1459  public Enum<?> getChosenEnum() {
1460    if (enumVisual == null)
1461      throw new IllegalStateException("SSComboBox values not an enum");
1462    K key = getChosenKey();
1463    if (key == null)
1464      return null;
1465    int enumIdx = ((Number) key).intValue();
1466    return (Enum<?>) enumVisual.getEnumConstants()[enumIdx];
1467  }

1469  /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
1470  //
1471  // Deal with non-standard GlazedList UP/DOWN arrow handling
1472  //
1473
1474  /**
1475   * When dealing with GlazedLists (1.11) restore expected combo behavior.
1476   * <p>
1477   * Per GL JavaDoc: {@link ca.odell.glazedlists.swing.AutoCompleteSupport}
1478   * <p>
1479   * 4. typing the up arrow key when the popup is visible and the selected element
1480   * is the first element causes the autocompletion to be cleared and the popup's
1481   * selection to be removed.
1482   * 6. typing the down arrow key when the popup is visible and the selected element is
1483   * the last element causes the autocompletion to be cleared and the popup's selection
1484   * to be removed
1485   *<p>
1486   * We want to restore the normal JComboBox behavior of not going past the first or
1487   * last item. This would be the ideal case, matching JComboBox.
1488   * If GlazedLists ever changes the arrow key behavior, this can be removed.
1489   */
1490  protected void glazedListArrowHandler() {
1491    // ADD KEY LISTENER - INTERCEPTING KEYPRESSED APPEARS TO BLOCK GL
1492    getEditor().getEditorComponent().addKeyListener(new KeyAdapter() {
1493      @Override
1494      // OVERRIDE KEYPRESSED, NOT KEYTYPED OR KEY RELEASED
1495      public void keyPressed(KeyEvent keyEvent) {
1496        int keyCode = keyEvent.getKeyCode();
1497        if (keyCode == KeyEvent.VK_UP) {
1498          logger.log(TRACE, () -> sf("%s: Intercepted UP key.", getColumnForLog()));
1499          if (getSelectedIndex() == 0) {
1500            keyEvent.consume();
1501            logger.log(DEBUG, () -> sf("%s: UP key consumed.", getColumnForLog()));
1502          }
1503        } else if (keyCode == KeyEvent.VK_DOWN) {
1504          logger.log(TRACE, () -> sf("%s: Intercepted DOWN key.", getColumnForLog()));
1505          if (getSelectedIndex() == getModel().getSize() - 1) {
1506            keyEvent.consume();
1507            logger.log(DEBUG, () -> sf("%s: DOWN key consumed.", getColumnForLog()));
1508          }
1509        }
1510      }
1511    });
1512  }

1604   * Override the default implementation to take combobox navigator
1605   * into account. If navigator then always false, don't need to check
1606   * database.

1614  /**
1615   * Add or remove the nullItem from the itemList if needed depending
1616   * on {@code getAllowNull()} and the current existence of a nullItem.
1617   * If logical null is selected before, keep it selected after.
1618   */
1619  protected void adjustForNullItem() {
1620    // 2021-01-20_BP: Slight modification needed to avoid Beep in combo navigator on
1621    //   insert row as DbOpsImpl calls setSelectionPending(true) and that will fail
1622    //   for the combo navigator without this tweak.
1623    //boolean wantNull = (getAllowNull() || selectionPending) && !isComboBoxNavigator();
1624    boolean wantNull = getAllowNull() || selectionPending;
1625    boolean hasNull = nullItem != null;
1626
1627    if (wantNull == hasNull) {
1628      // things are set up as wanted
1629      return;
1630    }
1631    try (Model.Remodel remodel = keyVisual.getRemodel()) {
1632      // Need to add or remove the nullItem
1633      // Since selection is based on item, not index, we only need
1634      // to consider adjusting the selection if the current selection:
1635      // A) null/-1 and nullItem is being added then select nullItem/0
1636      // B) nullItem/0 and nullItem is being removed then select null/-1.
1637      //
1638      // The whole idea is that if null was selected before this
1639      // change, want it seleted after the change.
1640      //
1641      // If listeners are enabled, may exceptions about using null
1642      boolean selectNull = false;
1643      boolean selectNone = false;
1644      if (wantNull) {
1645        selectNull = super.getSelectedIndex() == -1;
1646        //nullItem = remodel.createComboItem(null, "", null);
1647        nullItem = createNullItem(remodel);
1648        remodel.add(0, nullItem);
1649      } else {
1650        selectNone = super.getSelectedItem() == nullItem;
1651        remodel.remove(nullItem);
1652        nullItem = null;
1653      }
1654
1655      // Only manipulate listeners and selection if needed.
1656      // Note that if selected item was not null, then followin is not entered.
1657      if (selectNull || selectNone) {
1658        final ActionListener[] listeners = unregisterAllActionListeners(this);
1659        try {
1660          if (selectNull) {
1661            super.setSelectedItem(nullItem);
1662          }
1663          if (selectNone) {
1664            super.setSelectedItem(null);
1665          }
1666        } finally {
1667          registerAllActionListeners(this, listeners);
1668        }
1669      }
1670    }
1671  }

1673  /**
1674   * Updates the value stored and displayed in the SwingSet component based on
1675   * getColumnText().
1676   */
1677  @SuppressWarnings({"BroadCatchBlock", "TooBroadCatch", "UseSpecificCatch"})
1678  private void updateComponent() {
1679    // TODO Modify this class similar to updateSsComponent() in SSFormattedTextField and only limit JDBC types accepted
1680    try {
1681      // If initialization is taking place then there won't be any
1682      // keys so don't try to update anything yet.
1683      if (!hasItems()) {
1684        return;
1685      }
1686
1687      // Maybe insures blank in case of later exception.
1688      setSelectionPending(true);
1689
1690      logger.log(DEBUG, () -> sf("%s: getColumnText() - %s", getColumnForLog(), getColumnText()));
1691
1692      // https://github.com/bpangburn/swingset/issues/46
1693      K targetValue = getColumnObject(getKeyType());
1694
1695      logger.log(DEBUG, () -> sf("%s: targetValue - %s", getColumnForLog(), targetValue));
1696
1697      // Update component.
1698      setChosenKey(targetValue);
1699    } finally {
1700      cleanupMissingKeyVisuals();
1701    }
1702  }

1743  //
1744  // unregisterAllActionListeners/registerAllActionListeners kudos glazed lists
1745  //
1746  /**
1747   * A convenience method to unregister and return all {@link ActionListener}s
1748   * currently installed on the given <code>comboBox</code>. This is the only
1749   * technique we can rely on to prevent the <code>comboBox</code> from
1750   * broadcasting {@link ActionEvent}s at inappropriate times.
1751   * <p>
1752   * This method is the logical inverse of {@link #registerAllActionListeners}.
1753   * <p>
1754Note that the ActionListener used for binding will be removed without
1755passing through SSCommon.removeSsComponentListener()
1756   *
1757   * @param comboBox combo box from which to remove listeners
1758   * @return array of ActionListeners removed from combo box (for adding back later)
1759   */
1760  // TODO: Consider passing in SsComboBox2 and identifying ComboBox2Listener
1761  static ActionListener[] unregisterAllActionListeners(JComboBox<?> comboBox) {
1762    final ActionListener[] listeners = comboBox.getActionListeners();
1763    for (ActionListener listener : listeners) {
1764      comboBox.removeActionListener(listener);
1765    }
1766
1767    return listeners;
1768  }
1769
1770  /**
1771   * A convenience method to register all of the given <code>listeners</code>
1772   * with the given <code>comboBox</code>.
1773   * <p>
1774   * This method is the logical inverse of {@link #unregisterAllActionListeners}.
1775   * <p>
1776Note that the ActionListener used for binding will be removed without
1777passing through SSCommon.addSsComponentListener()
1778   *
1779   * @param comboBox combo box for which to add listeners
1780   * @param listeners array of ActionListners to be
1781   */
1782  // TODO: Consider passing in SsComboBox2 and identifying ComboBox2Listener
1783  static void registerAllActionListeners(JComboBox<?> comboBox, ActionListener[] listeners) {
1784    for (ActionListener listener : listeners) {
1785      comboBox.addActionListener(listener);
1786    }
1787  }
